$comment: Every fork add-on. files: fork-owned files it owns (absent upstream). hooks: upstream files where its lines carry `Fork add-on(<id>)`. extensionPoints: the core registries an upstream file (or the feature that owns them) hooks once, and the add-ons registered in each. unmarkedUpstreamEdits: upstream files that cannot hold a marker. upstreamDeletions: upstream lines it removes outright, which no marker can sit on. dependsOn: add-ons whose fork-owned files it imports; a registry importing an add-on registers it, so core depends on none. Update this in the same change as the code. See docs/internals/fork-add-ons.md.

tiers.core: Shared plumbing every other add-on hooks into.
tiers.fix: A small behavior fix to upstream code that upstream does not have.
tiers.distribution: How the fork is built, named, signed, installed and updated.
tiers.personal: The owner's own tooling and instructions; skip when adopting add-ons.

mobile: No add-on changes the mobile app. Fork wire additions are optional fields that upstream clients ignore.
